common.showingNewest: Showing the newest {count}. Narrow the filters to see older rows.

notices.invalid: The request was malformed; nothing changed.
notices.jobRetried: Job put back in the queue with fresh attempts. The minute cron (or the inline kick) runs it.
notices.jobRetryRefused: Only failed or cancelled jobs can be retried.
notices.jobCancelRefused: Only queued or running jobs can be cancelled.
notices.sourceQueued: Source run queued; it starts within a minute.
notices.sourceAlreadyQueued: A run of this source was queued in the last minutes already.
notices.approved: Opportunity approved: active, and public when its type has public pages.
notices.rejected: Opportunity rejected; it no longer appears anywhere.
notices.creditsGranted: {amount, plural, one {# credit granted} other {# credits granted}}.
notices.creditsExisting: That adjustment key was used before for this user, so nothing new was granted.
notices.addressBlocked: Address blocked: no Onward Scout user can email it again.

overview.title: Overview
overview.lede: The business and the pipeline right now. Every number is live from the database.
overview.revenueHint: {count, plural, one {# paid order} other {# paid orders}}
overview.errorsHint: {count, plural, one {# warning} other {# warnings}} too

users.title: Users
users.lede: One row per account that has opened the app. Credits are what the person can spend right now (unexpired, active lots).
users.searchLabel: Search by email or user id
users.empty: No one has signed in yet.

user.title: User
user.name: Name
user.grantBody: A goodwill or support adjustment: a new lot that expires after 180 days. The key makes it idempotent: the same key never grants twice for this person.
user.keyHint: Letters, digits and dashes, e.g. support-2026-10-21

applications.title: Applications
applications.lede: Every application across users. Open one for its step log, its jobs and a retry for a failed step.

opportunities.title: Opportunities
opportunities.lede: The review queue holds unverified and user-imported opportunities. Approve to make one active (and public when its type has public pages), reject to hide it.

opportunity.title: Edit opportunity
opportunity.lede: Core fields only. Unknown stays empty: never guess a deadline, an amount or a rule.
opportunity.name: Name
opportunity.deadlineHint: Leave empty when the official page gives none.
opportunity.publicHint: Only types with public pages can be public.

sources.title: Sources
sources.lede: Every feed and board we crawl. “Run now” queues a sources.run job for one source; “Refresh all boards now” queues one full pass (at most once an hour). The minute cron runs them.
sources.empty: No sources yet. The seed runner (scripts/sources) creates them.
sources.noPass: The scheduled pass has not reported yet.

jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.lede: The Postgres queue. Failed and cancelled jobs can be retried with fresh attempts; queued and running ones cancelled.
jobs.lastDrain: Last drain {when}: {claimed} claimed, {done} done, {failed} failed, {retried} retried.
jobs.noDrain: The drain has not reported yet.

llm.title: LLM
llm.lede: Every model call is logged with tokens and cost. The local engine costs nothing and is logged too.
llm.providerLocal: Local engine: heuristic parsing, rule-based matching and template drafts from the person's facts. Output is labelled “drafted from your profile”.
llm.providerAnthropic: Claude through the Anthropic API, with the local engine as fallback on errors and over budget.
llm.providerMock: Canned output for tests. Never on production.
llm.noFailures: No failed calls in the last 7 days.

orders.title: Orders
orders.lede: Stripe checkouts recorded by the success page, the webhook and the nightly reconcile. Amounts in the order's currency.

errors.title: Error inbox
errors.lede: Grouped by fingerprint (error name, first stack frame, route). A resolved group that recurs reopens by itself. Open server errors turn /api/health red.
errors.healthWarning: {count, plural, one {# unresolved server error keeps} other {# unresolved server errors keep}} /api/health at 503.
errors.empty: Nothing recorded. Prove the pipeline with the drills above.

messages.title: Messages
messages.lede: Contact-form submissions. Each one was also mailed to the owner inbox. Reply from your mail client, then mark it replied here.
messages.blockLabel: Block an address from all outreach (someone asked not to be contacted)

inbox.title: Test inbox
inbox.lede: Mail to test@onwardscout.com, the catch-all and the reply drop-boxes, delivered by Cloudflare Email Routing to the mail worker. SPF, DKIM and DMARC verdicts come from Authentication-Results; a six-digit code is pulled out for sign-in tests.
inbox.empty: Empty. Send anything to test@onwardscout.com and it appears here within a minute.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.lede: Prove the plumbing end to end. Drills name themselves “Diagnostics:” so their errors can be resolved in one click afterwards.
diagnostics.logEmpty: Nothing run yet in this tab.

drill.throwBody: A route handler throws. Expect an inbox entry with source server, /api/health at 503 and one owner alert.
drill.throwOk: The server threw and answered 500: the error is in the inbox, and /api/health stays red until you resolve it.
drill.clientBody: This tab throws an uncaught error. Expect an inbox entry with source client and this page's route.
drill.clientOk: Client error thrown. It reaches the inbox within a few seconds.
drill.resolveBody: Marks every open error whose message starts with “Diagnostics:” resolved, so /api/health can turn green again.
drill.resolveOk: {count, plural, one {# drill error resolved} other {# drill errors resolved}}.
drill.alertBody: One email to the owner through the mail worker's /notify.
drill.alertOk: The mail worker accepted the alert. Check the owner inbox.
drill.notifyBody: One in-app notification for your account (and an email when Resend is configured).
drill.notifyOk: Notification stored. Open the bell in the app to see it.
drill.digestTitle: Send me my weekly brief now
drill.digestBody: Builds your own brief from your data and stores it as a notification, even when nothing happened this week.
